title: Final Synthesis Report — Consolidated Findings & Recommendations
description: Produce the final consolidated report that synthesizes all research findings into a single coherent document. This is the last stage — it depends on all other task cards. The report must include: (1) Executive summary: top-line recommendation for each scenario in 1 paragraph, (2) Complete comparison table: all 9 hardware items + cloud baseline across all 8 attributes (price, VRAM, bandwidth, tokens/s, training score, power, compatibility, cost-performance score), (3) Cost-performance ranked list with formula explanation, (4) Scenario-based Top-1 recommendations with detailed justification, (5) Mac vs NVIDIA quantified comparison (not just separate analysis), (6) Risk analysis summary with mitigation strategies, (7) All assumptions documented in a dedicated section, (8) Source bibliography with all URLs, (9) Confidence level for each major claim (high/medium/low based on source agreement), (10) Limitations of the analysis (what could not be measured, what was estimated). The report must be self-contained — a reader should be able to make an informed GPU purchase decision based solely on this document.
